subject: Can I do QTL (geno-pheno association) analysis without linkage map using r/qtl

messages.author: 19ca9eb1c23a28c4
messages.subject: Can I do QTL (geno-pheno association) analysis without linkage map using r/qtl
parts:
Hi there,
I have 150 tomato F2 lines. I want to do analysis to see which marker is associated with my trait on interest,
The population is genotyped with SNPs. We know there positions on tomato genome.
I am wondering is there any possibility in R/QTL to do analysis without construction linkage map ?
If yes what sort of analysis I can do ?

your help would be much appreciated.

ps. sorry if its bit vague. i,m totally new to this field.

cheers

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Can I do QTL (geno-pheno association) analysis without linkage map using r/qtl
parts:
I would start with the physical positions in the tomato genome, in Mbp. Then either use an estimate of cM/Mbp for tomato to convert to genetic distances, or estimate the map positions using the available marker data.

karl
